decision_rule: Existing structured and deterministic outputs are not model comparisons. A concern is approved only when its reviewed judgment can be represented as provider-neutral binary probabilities with deterministic local composition.

concerns.current_input: Frozen day, embedded articles, source cluster set, and a reviewed article pair.
concerns.current_metric: Whether reviewed same-event or different-event article anchors have the expected group relation.
concerns.current_gate: Each case passes only when the frozen clustering relation equals expected_same_group.
concerns.proposed_shared_output: Probability that the reviewed article pair describes the same news event.
concerns.proposed_metric: Binary accuracy, class-specific error counts, exact intervals, paired correctness, and control preservation.
concerns.proposed_gate: Complete coverage and preservation of every reviewed control; any deployment threshold must be frozen from disjoint calibration before v11 execution.
concerns.calibration_source: Prospectively reviewed post-2026-09-11 article pairs disjoint from v11 by article/version/content/URL/feedback/report/group identity.
concerns.rationale: The pair relation preserves the reviewed judgment, but it is a new derived benchmark rather than the original partition-generation task.

concerns.current_input: Frozen groups, per-article relevance evidence, and reviewed higher/lower group anchors.
concerns.current_output: A complete ordered report group list.
concerns.current_metric: Whether the reviewed higher anchor precedes the lower anchor.
concerns.current_gate: Each case passes only when higher_group_id precedes lower_group_id in the frozen output.
concerns.proposed_shared_output: Probability that group A should rank above group B for the reader.
concerns.proposed_metric: Pairwise accuracy, inversion counts, exact intervals, paired correctness, and control preservation.
concerns.proposed_gate: Complete coverage and preservation of every reviewed control; any deployment threshold must be frozen from disjoint calibration before v11 execution.
concerns.calibration_source: Prospectively reviewed post-2026-09-11 group pairs disjoint from v11 reports, groups, articles, feedback, and content.
concerns.rationale: Pairwise precedence is shared across providers, but does not measure construction of a globally coherent report order.

concerns.current_input: A frozen reviewed subject or group anchor and its report context.
concerns.current_output: One of main, worth_knowing, or excluded as part of a complete daily assessment.
concerns.current_metric: Exact equality with the reviewed three-class tier after registered merge resolutions.
concerns.current_gate: Each non-superseded case passes only when observed_tier equals expected_tier.
concerns.proposed_shared_output: Two probabilities: main; if not main, worth knowing rather than excluded. Compose the three-class tier locally.
concerns.proposed_metric: Three-class confusion matrix, per-tier recall, exact accuracy, paired correctness, and control preservation.
concerns.proposed_gate: Complete coverage and preservation of every reviewed control; per-tier thresholds must be frozen from disjoint calibration before v11 execution.
concerns.calibration_source: Prospectively reviewed post-2026-09-11 report subjects disjoint from v11 subject, group, report, article, feedback, and content identities.
concerns.rationale: Two binary questions represent all three labels without provider-specific structured output, but no longer test complete assessment generation.

concerns.current_input: Frozen report evidence and the reviewed sufficiency expectation.
concerns.current_output: Whether evidence was presented as sufficient without an uncertainty disclosure.
concerns.current_gate: Each case passes only when the observed sufficiency state equals the reviewed label.
concerns.proposed_shared_output: Probability that the evidence is sufficient without an uncertainty disclosure.
concerns.proposed_metric: Exact accuracy, error IDs, paired correctness, and control preservation; intervals are mandatory because n=4.
concerns.proposed_gate: Complete coverage and preservation of every reviewed control; no winner claim or deployment gate may rely on four v11 cases alone.
concerns.calibration_source: Prospectively reviewed post-2026-09-11 evidence/disclosure examples disjoint from v11 reports, groups, articles, feedback, and content.
concerns.rationale: The sufficiency judgment is binary and shared, but the tiny pinned sample supports only descriptive evidence.

concerns.current_input: A frozen day of groups and summaries with reviewed must-link and must-separate group pairs.
concerns.current_metric: Must-link recall, must-separate preservation, and report usefulness including a non-singleton requirement.
concerns.current_gate: Reviewed report cases require 100% must-link recall, 100% must-separate preservation, and at least one non-singleton theme.
concerns.proposed_shared_output: Probability that each of the 27 reviewed group pairs belongs to one reader subject.
concerns.proposed_metric: Must-link recall, must-separate preservation, exact intervals, paired correctness, and control preservation.
concerns.proposed_gate: Complete coverage with 100% reviewed must-link and must-separate preservation; partition usefulness remains outside the derived pairwise benchmark.
concerns.calibration_source: Prospectively reviewed post-2026-09-11 group pairs disjoint from v11 reports, groups, articles, feedback, and content.
concerns.rationale: Pair classification preserves the reviewed relations, but cannot establish transitivity, full partition validity, or non-singleton usefulness.

concerns.current_input: Frozen generated title, summary, and key points.
concerns.current_metric: Deterministic word, character, sentence, key-point count, and forbidden-title-label checks.
concerns.current_gate: All deterministic format limits must pass.
concerns.proposed_shared_output: No model output; retain _summary_format_failures as the authority.
concerns.proposed_metric: Deterministic pass/fail with explicit failed limits.
concerns.calibration_source: None; thresholds are product constraints, not learned judgments.
concerns.rationale: Calling a model would replace exact validation with a less reliable semantic judgment.

concerns.current_gate: The registered presentation expectation must pass.
concerns.proposed_shared_output: No model output; retain _evaluate_reader_expectation as the authority.
concerns.proposed_metric: Deterministic pass/fail with observed and required values.
concerns.calibration_source: None; values are measured product behavior.
concerns.rationale: The checks measure UI and provenance facts that a language model should not infer.

forecast.cost_rule: Price 132 calls per model/trial from calibrated observed tokens and current provider rates, then register a hard cap before execution. No paid call is authorized by this mapping alone.
